schema: CREATE TABLE t2s_products (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(100), category VARCHAR(50), price NUMERIC(10, 2)); CREATE TABLE t2s_customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(100), region VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE t2s_sales (id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER, amount NUMERIC(10, 2), sale_date DATE, customer_id INTEGER);
